answer: Proof of stake serves as a defensive grove against Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral. Like a shift in a dune, the validator set evolves based on wealth distribution, ensuring influence remains proportional to economic skin in the game. A cryptographically secure beacon provides the entropy necessary for leader selection, forcing an attacker to acquire a majority of total supply to successfully inflate their identity count, an act that carries prohibitive financial costs.
